cards.ex: After that grueling workout, I could barely walk.
cards.exUz: O'sha qiyin mashqdan so'ng, men zo'rg'a yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiyin va charchatadigan mashqlar bajarish, zo'riqish.

cards.ex: Running is a great way to burn calories.
cards.exUz: Yugurish - bu kaloriyalarni yoqishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy faoliyat orqali tanadagi kaloriyalarni sarflash.

cards.ex: She got a head start by arriving early at the marathon.
cards.exUz: U marafonning erta boshlanishi bilan oldindan boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Musobaqada yoki mashqda boshqalardan oldinroq boshlash.

cards.ex: The athlete needs to be in tip-top shape for the Olympics.
cards.exUz: Sportchi Olimpiya o'yinlari uchun eng zo'r holatda bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi jismoniy holatda bo'lish, a'lo darajada.

cards.ex: The coach helped him reach his full potential as a swimmer.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy unga suzuvchi sifatida o'z salohiyatiga to'liq erishishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining eng yuqori qobiliyatlariga erishish, imkoniyatlarni ishga solish.

cards.ex: It's tough, but you need to stay the course to finish the marathon.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin, lekin marafonni tugatish uchun siz yo'lda qolishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, maqsadga erishish uchun davom etish.

cards.ex: He's always pushing the envelope in his athletic training.
cards.exUz: U doimo sport mashg'ulotlarida chegarani kengaytirishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ko'proq harakat qilish, yangi chegaralarga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Alright team, it's time to get your game face on!
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, jamoa, jiddiy bo'lish vaqti keldi!
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jamlash va musobaqaga tayyorlanish, jiddiy munosabatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The competition wasn't a walk in the park, it was really tough.
cards.exUz: Musobaqa oson ish emas edi, u juda qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson va hech qanday qiyinchilik tug'dirmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: He has the stamina to go the distance in the race.
cards.exUz: U poygada oxirigacha borish uchun chidamlilikka ega.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida davom etish va maqsadga erishish.

cards.ex: The coach called him off the bench to turn the game around.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy uni o'yinni o'zgartirish uchun zahiradan chaqirdi.
cards.uzDef: Zahiradagi o'yinchini asosiy tarkibga kiritish.

cards.ex: Many athletes suffer sports-related injuries during their careers.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina sportchilar faoliyati davomida sport jarohatlariga duch kelishadi.
cards.uzDef: Sport bilan shug'ullanish natijasida olingan jarohatlar.

cards.ex: She decided to adopt a healthier lifestyle and started exercising.
cards.exUz: U sog'lom turmush tarzini qabul qilishga qaror qildi va mashq qilishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi turmush tarzini boshlash va unga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: She was really on top of her game during the tournament.
cards.exUz: Turnir davomida u o'z ishida haqiqatan ham eng yaxshi natijalarga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishida eng yaxshi natijalarga erishish.

cards.ex: He trained hard to break records at the competition.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada rekordlarni yangilash uchun qattiq mashq qildi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi eng yaxshi natijalardan o'tish.

cards.ex: It can be hard to stay motivated when you're training alone.
cards.exUz: Yolg'iz mashq qilganda motivatsiyada qolish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun qat'iyatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: After the injury, it took months to get back on track.
cards.exUz: Jarohatdan so'ng, izga qaytish uchun oylar kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatiga qaytish, tuzalib ketish.

cards.ex: Long-distance running helps to build stamina.
cards.exUz: Uzoq masofaga yugurish chidamlilikni oshirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy chidamlilikni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: She follows a strict fitness routine to stay healthy.
cards.exUz: U sog'lom bo'lish uchun qat'iy fitnes tartibiga amal qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muntazam ravishda bajariladigan mashqlar to'plami.

cards.ex: The sports competition was held last weekend.
cards.exUz: Sport musobaqasi o'tgan hafta oxirida bo'lib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Sportchilar o'zaro bellashadigan tadbir.

cards.ex: Mental toughness is key to success in any sport.
cards.exUz: Ruhiy chidamlilik har qanday sportda muvaffaqiyatning kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: His physical prowess was evident on the field.
cards.exUz: Uning jismoniy mahorati maydonda yaqqol ko'zga tashlandi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy kuch va qobiliyatning yuqori darajasi.

cards.ex: He needed a moment to regain his composure after the mistake.
cards.exUz: Xatodan so'ng o'zini tutish uchun unga bir oz vaqt kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayajon yoki asabiylikdan so'ng o'zini nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: I do a cardio workout three times a week.
cards.exUz: Men haftada uch marta kardio mashq qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Yurak-qon tomir tizimini kuchaytirishga qaratilgan mashqlar.

cards.ex: Athletes constantly push boundaries to achieve new records.
cards.exUz: Sportchilar doimo yangi rekordlarga erishish uchun chegaralarni surishadi.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatlar chegarasidan o'tishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Proper muscle recovery is essential for avoiding injuries.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri muskul tiklanishi jarohatlardan qochish uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Mashqdan keyin mushaklarning tiklanishi.

cards.ex: The runners were dropping like flies in the heat.
cards.exUz: Issiqda yuguruvchilar tez va ko'p miqdorda tushib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va ko'p miqdorda mag'lub bo'lish yoki tushib qolish.

cards.ex: He's a sports fanatic and knows everything about every team.
cards.exUz: U sport muxlisi va har bir jamoa haqida hamma narsani biladi.
cards.uzDef: Sportga juda qiziqadigan va muxlislik qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: The sports commentators provided insightful analysis during the game.
cards.exUz: Sport sharhlovchilari o'yin davomida chuqur tahlil qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Sport musobaqalarini sharhlab boruvchi odamlar.

cards.ex: Even in defeat, sportsmanship prevails.
cards.exUz: Mag'lubiyatda ham sport odobi g'alaba qozonadi.
cards.uzDef: Sportda adolat va hurmat g'alaba qozonadi.
